text:
maya (PM): Quick sync — need alignment on headroom commit playbook for reserved capacity. TL;DR: propose a 2-week soft buffer, clear oncall escalation rules, and an opt-in carryover billing option. Thoughts?

omar (Eng): +1 on soft buffer. Q: how do we decide auto-scale vs preempt path? we should avoid oscillation.

raj (Infra): can do. proposal: maintain a preempt_margin metric and only preempt if headroom < X for Y minutes. ops oncall gets an alert when headroom < 10% for 5m.

leah (Sales): customers keep asking for guaranteed burst. They'll accept a soft buffer if they get visibility (dashboard) + predictable credits. important for renewals. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

nora (Finance): carryover + credits will affect revenue recognition and deferred rev. Contract language must be explicit: "soft carryover up to N credits, expires after Z days". we need standard template.

maya (PM): Proposed experiment: 3 pilot customers, 30-day pilot. Metrics: 99th p99 latency, number of denied bursts, billing delta. Launch criteria: <2% cost increase vs baseline and <=2 denied-burst incidents/week across pilots.

omar (Eng): infra knobs we need: soft_headroom_percent and preempt_window_minutes. rough config example: ```json
{"soft_headroom_percent": 15, "preempt_window_minutes": 10, "carryover_window_days": 30}
```

raj (Infra): oncall/runbook note: add a new escalation -> if headroom alert fires 3x in 1h escalate to capacity-oncall and enable temporary autoscale bypass. draft runbook: https://go/runbooks/reserved-headroom (WIP).

ci-bot: Document created: /docs/product/reserved-headroom-playbook-draft.md

maya (PM): UX/APIs: add reserve_policy flag: "soft" | "strict" and expose remaining_headroom and carryover_credits in the console + usage API. SDKs should reflect new fields.

leah (Sales): can we add an "opt-in billing" checkbox in the contract UI and a line item for carryover credits? sales needs that to close pilots quickly.

nora (Finance): +1. I'll draft a pro-forma invoice and billing FAQ. need legal to sign off on expiration terms.

maya (PM): I'll own the PRD and rollout plan. Action items: PRD + runbook + pilot contract template + pilot dashboard mock. Can we sync Thu 10:00am PT? @omar @raj @leah @nora

omar (Eng): works for me :thumbsup:

raj (Infra): can do

leah (Sales): yep

nora (Finance): yes

maya (PM): thanks — I'll post the PRD in #product and link here when ready.
